title: Topography you can touch
summary: Our augmented-reality sandbox projects elevation bands and contour lines onto the sand as you shape it, and rains wherever you hold a hand. Not research, just the quickest way we know to explain a contour line.

video.alt: Hands held over the SDSC augmented-reality sandbox while projected rain runs down the contoured sand and fills a basin.

members.highlight: Jia-Jun Chang did the woodwork and assembled the sandbox.
Chen-Lun Kao tested the software and poured in the sand.
